# Getting started

A plugin is one `.CVP` file. Read "The rules" in [the plugin rules](plugin-rules.md#the-id) first.

## 1. Tools

`tools/check.sh` checks screenshots, and `docs/hardware.md` lists the chips.
The icons are in `docs/icons.md`; `docs/nothing.md` isn't in the kit, and neither is `build/HELLO.CVP`.

```sh
# not a heading
cmake -B build
```

See `examples/sound` and the [SDK](../sdk/firmware/revc/sdk/README.md).
